scriptSource:
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'V:\_worktrees\Playbook\agent-pin-800-04-028-retain-deliberate-loading-hints-during-enhanced'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$true
$root=(Get-Location).Path
$dotnet='C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe'
$node='C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'
$inspector=(Resolve-Path './artifacts/inspector/node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/inspector/clients/launcher/build/index.js').Path
$scratch=Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('playbook-pin800-stdio5-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$scratch/feed","$scratch/home","$scratch/cache","$scratch/tool","$scratch/cwd" -Force|Out-Null
Copy-Item ./artifacts/PIN-800/v5/packages/*.nupkg "$scratch/feed/"
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$scratch/NuGet.Config","<configuration><packageSources><clear/><add key='only-local' value='$scratch/feed'/></packageSources><config><add key='globalPackagesFolder' value='$scratch/cache'/></config></configuration>")
$env:DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH='0'
$env:DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE='false'
$env:DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE='1'
$env:DOTNET_CLI_HOME="$scratch/home"
$env:NUGET_PACKAGES="$scratch/cache"
$env:NUGET_HTTP_CACHE_PATH="$scratch/http"
Push-Location "$scratch/cwd"
try {
  & $dotnet tool install PinguApps.Playbook --version 0.0.0-pin800.5 --tool-path "$scratch/tool" --configfile "$scratch/NuGet.Config" --no-cache *> "$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/install.log"
  $exe="$scratch/tool/playbook.exe"
  $tools=& $node $inspector --cli --format json --quiet --method tools/list -- $exe mcp
  $tools|Set-Content "$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/tools.json"
  $discovery=& $node $inspector --cli --format json --quiet --method tools/call --tool-name list_recipes --tool-arg 'targetVersion="11.0"' --tool-arg 'query=tern-ledger' -- $exe mcp
  $discovery|Set-Content "$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/discovery.json"
  $detail=& $node $inspector --cli --format json --quiet --method tools/call --tool-name get_recipe --tool-arg 'targetVersion="11.0"' --tool-arg 'id=blazor.preload-needed-resources' -- $exe mcp
  $detail|Set-Content "$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/detail.json"
  $recipe=($detail|ConvertFrom-Json).result.structuredContent.recipe
  $json=($recipe|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 60).Replace("`r`n","`n")+"`n"
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/installed-recipe.json",$json)
  $current=[System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode]::Parse($json)
  foreach($old in @("$root/artifacts/PIN-800/installed-recipe.json","$root/artifacts/PIN-800/inspect/recipe.json")){
    if(-not [System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode]::DeepEquals($current,[System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode]::Parse([IO.File]::ReadAllText($old)))){throw 'ENTIRE recipe drift; cannot reuse browser/body proof'}
  }
  $dll=Get-ChildItem "$scratch/tool/.store" -Recurse -Filter PinguApps.Playbook.dll
  if(@($dll).Count -ne 1){throw 'Installed DLL identity ambiguous'}
  $hash=(Get-FileHash $dll.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  if($hash -cne (Get-FileHash "$root/src/PinguApps.Playbook/bin/Release/net10.0/PinguApps.Playbook.dll").Hash.ToLowerInvariant()){throw 'Inspector/packed DLL mismatch'}
  $receipt=@{recordedAt=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o');sourceCommit='4bee8916d9bbbe305f23a4d42676385ebd41b76a';sourceDirty=$false;directory=$scratch;workingDirectory=(Get-Location).Path;isolatedFeedCacheHome=$true;toolsListActual=$true;listGetActual=$true;entireRecipeDeepEqualsOriginalExecutedBody=$true;entireRecipeDeepEqualsCurrentInspector=$true;toolDllSha256=$hash;recipeSha256=(Get-FileHash "$root/artifacts/PIN-800/v5/installed-recipe.json").Hash.ToLowerInvariant();scriptSource=[IO.File]::ReadAllText("$root/artifacts/PIN-800/Installed-v5.ps1")}
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$root/docs/verification/PIN-800.v5-installed.evidence.json",($receipt|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30).Replace("`r`n","`n")+"`n")
} finally {Pop-Location}
'PASS actual fresh installed stdio entire recipe equality + exact Inspector/packed DLL'
